purpose: Controlled source category taxonomy for the Virtual Advocate PI AI/RAG knowledge base.
safetyRule: Only approved, active and non-archived source registry entries using these categories should be available for retrieval and AI prompt-building.

categories.description: Approved guidance or internal explanatory material related to GARP M-aware preparation, lifestyle impact prompts and functional impact drafting.
categories.safetyNotes: Must not calculate impairment points or present GARP outcomes as official.

categories.description: Approved references about DVA reform, PI claim preparation context and post-reform workflow considerations.
categories.safetyNotes: Must not provide legal advice or predict DVA decisions.

categories.description: Approved references explaining general DVA process concepts, evidence organisation and preparation steps.
categories.safetyNotes: Must remain general and must not claim that a particular action guarantees success.

categories.description: Approved internal templates used to structure veteran statements, worsening summaries, doctor letters and claim pack cover notes.
categories.safetyNotes: Templates must keep user-review wording and preparation-only disclaimers.

categories.description: Approved safety wording, refusal boundaries and prompt constraints for AI-assisted drafting.
categories.safetyNotes: Must be included in prompt-building for all AI draft generation tasks.

categories.description: Approved evidence collection prompts, evidence gap wording and plain-English evidence organisation guidance.
categories.safetyNotes: Must not state that evidence is legally or medically sufficient.

categories.description: Approved question templates for helping a veteran prepare for a doctor, specialist or support appointment.
categories.safetyNotes: Must not instruct a doctor what opinion to provide and must not pressure for a diagnosis.

categories.description: Approved structure and wording templates for generated preparation packs and cover notes.
categories.safetyNotes: Must clearly label outputs as preparation support only.

categories.description: Approved structure and wording templates for plain-English veteran statements.
categories.safetyNotes: Must preserve user voice and avoid exaggeration, certainty or legal conclusions.

categories.description: Approved templates for explaining change over time, current impact and evidence gaps in worsening-related preparation.
categories.safetyNotes: Must not assert medical causation or formal worsening unless the user has provided supporting details.

sourceTypes.description: External or formal reference material approved for retrieval.
Approved explanatory guidance used to support plain-English drafting.
Approved internal wording or structure template.
Approved safety wording or prompt constraint.
Internal explanatory note approved for retrieval or prompt construction.
